authority.format: PROJECT_CONTRACT.md section 10; dialogue.json retains only speaker/text/mood.
authority.line_metadata: This file's lines records bind by scene_id and zero-based line_index. The stable id is the external reference; do not persist array indices.
authority.integration_status: Content handoff. Semantic completion events, added flags and scene anchors below are requirements for Claude's systems, not existing engine APIs.

text_presentation.portrait_position: left for both characters, facing right toward text
text_presentation.wrap: Word-wrap within the existing dialogue text area; at most two text rows. Do not insert hard newlines in canonical text.

voice_narrator.tone: Soft breath-like text tone, subdued and impartial.

voice_dave.tone: Warm, firm human murmur; restrained grief becomes steady resolve.

voice_pharaoh.tone: Low, dry, resonant murmur; controlled menace, intelligible consonant-free texture.

blip_playback.eligible_characters: ASCII letters and digits only; no sounds for whitespace or punctuation.
blip_playback.cadence: One blip per second eligible revealed character; reset counter at each line.
blip_playback.variant_choice: Select among the available variants without consecutive repeats.
blip_playback.on_instant_reveal_advance_or_skip: Cancel pending and playing blips; never synthesize all unrevealed sounds.
blip_playback.missing_asset_fallback: Use available variants; if none exist, remain silent.

intro_020.speaker: narrator
intro_020.text: Dave alone had survived the siege.

intro_030.speaker: narrator
intro_030.text: The enemy had taken the original Holy Grail.

intro_050.speaker: dave
intro_050.text: I will return the Holy Grail to the Holy Sanctuary.

intro_060.speaker: dave
intro_060.text: I swear it. I will reunite our people and bring them home.

intro_070.speaker: narrator
intro_070.text: Beyond the broken walls, the desert waited.

boss_intro_020.speaker: pharaoh
boss_intro_020.text: You shall not pass. This desert will be your grave.

objective_quest_010.speaker: narrator
objective_quest_010.text: Return the Holy Grail to the Holy Sanctuary. Reunite the people of the Holy City.

checkpoint_prompt_010.speaker: narrator
checkpoint_prompt_010.text: Interact with the star to save.

checkpoint_overwrite_010.speaker: narrator
checkpoint_overwrite_010.text: Replace this slot with your current journey?

objective_quest.trigger: Overall quest context; optional pause-menu objective field if provided by the UI. Never add a permanent quest HUD.

checkpoint_events.checkpoint_prompt: Player within interaction range of a safe yellow-star checkpoint; remove on leaving.
checkpoint_events.checkpoint_choose: Checkpoint interaction opens the existing three-slot save UI.
checkpoint_events.checkpoint_overwrite: Only after an occupied slot is selected; existing UI provides Confirm and Cancel.
checkpoint_events.checkpoint_saved: Only after the selected save slot and its healed checkpoint snapshot are successfully committed.
checkpoint_events.checkpoint_failed: After a failed save attempt; do not show success or consume a slot.
checkpoint_events.checkpoint_restored: Only after a selected checkpoint snapshot has finished loading.

arrival_spawn.source: Authored New Game player start from the room layout; use the same safe position as the first-death fallback.

boss_arena.source: The main-route boss room between Pharaoh's Gate and rm_d18_dungeon_threshold; resolve from Claude's room graph.
boss_arena.entry: Use the existing fully-inside gate trigger and staging point.
boss_arena.reward: Use the boss room's authored persistent unique-reward ID.

ending_threshold.source: The plane inside the dungeon doorway, reachable only after boss_pharaoh_defeated.

establish: Set intro_seen = true in the current run.
Enter rm_d01_arrival at its authored safe player start, facing east (direction index 0).
Keep starter loadout and health established by New Game; do not grant or reset either here.
Set the active local objective to objective_desert; retain objective_quest as the overall quest.
Keep boss_pharaoh_defeated = false and grail_recovered = false for this new run.
Clear cinematic overlays, input locks and pending shot callbacks; restore gameplay camera, health HUD, hotbar, normal damage rules and exploration audio only after the destination room is ready.
Show the same objective_desert toast after normal playback or skip. Establish a safe initial restart snapshot if no checkpoint has been saved.
must_not: Spawn Dave inside the cinematic backdrop or teleport him east of the authored arrival.

establish: Keep Dave fully inside the boss arena at the authored entry staging point; preserve current HP, equipment and inventory.
Ensure the entrance gate is closed, collidable and exits are locked before releasing control.
Ensure exactly one Pharaoh exists and is initialized for this attempt, with full HP only if this is a fresh encounter.
Set boss_intro_seen = true and consume the attempt-local entry trigger; boss_pharaoh_defeated stays false.
Clear dialogue, restore the arena camera and health/hotbar, show ui_boss_name and boss HP, start mus_pharaoh once, and set objective_pharaoh.
Enable the combat controller only after all entry conditions hold. Schedule the first telegraphed attack no earlier than 0.75 s after control returns.
Consume held advance/skip inputs until release before attack, interact or pause can trigger.
must_not: Advance to a defeated boss state.
Reset an already active boss's HP or duplicate the boss, gates, music or summons.

establish: Stop all attack scheduling and damage immediately.
Set boss_pharaoh_defeated = true; remove the Pharaoh, encounter summons, projectiles, warnings and hazards; stop their looping audio.
Open the arena entrance and the route to the dungeon; remove the boss health bar.

Call engineering's idempotent boss reward routine once for pharaoh_ankh, using the authored boss reward's persistent ID. If inventory is full, keep the unique reward available under the existing loot rules; do not silently claim or discard it.
Set objective_dungeon. Keep grail_recovered = false and chapter_1_complete = false.
Clear fades and input locks, restore gameplay camera/HUD/audio, consume held inputs and release Dave in the cleared arena.
must_not: Allow skipping before a legitimate zero-HP event.
Count the Pharaoh's ankh as the Holy Grail.
Enter the dungeon or complete the chapter on the player's behalf.
Write over a player-selected save slot.

establish: Retain boss_pharaoh_defeated = true and grail_recovered = false.
Set chapter_1_complete = true and ending_seen = true in current run state; preserve inventory and reward status.
Enter rm_ending, remove world control/HUD/damage and all remaining scene callbacks; show ui_ending_title and ui_return_menu.
Stop wind, footsteps and dialogue blips; fade any abandoned music to the ending tail or silence.
Keep the title visible until a fresh explicit menu input. Consume the input that skipped the scene so it cannot also activate Return to Main Menu.
must_not: Set grail_recovered = true or reunite the city on screen.
Automatically leave the title, grant an item or overwrite any save slot.

boss_intro.timing: Reading target only; both lines require advance. Hold each text shot until acknowledged.
boss_intro.trigger: Dave fully crosses the authored boss entrance trigger; boss_pharaoh_defeated is false; encounter is not already active.

shots.camera: Hold the arena gameplay camera with Dave inside the gate and the Pharaoh ahead.
shots.character_poses: Dave halts facing up. Pharaoh floats facing down, rod grounded visually; no attack pose.
shots.environment_motion: Gate closes behind Dave; sand density decreases so portraits and the arena remain clear.

shots.camera: Keep Dave and Pharaoh visible at native scale; no camera shake.
shots.character_poses: Dave squares his shoulders, sword held low, facing up; use his neutral portrait on the left.
shots.environment_motion: Only cape movement and a faint dust drift continue.

shots.camera: Hold the same camera. Change only the current speaker portrait.
shots.character_poses: Pharaoh tilts his headdress downward and inclines the rod without charging it; menace portrait on the left.
shots.environment_motion: He floats gently; no lightning, summons or damage effects.

shots.camera: Settle onto the normal arena camera.
shots.character_poses: Both return to combat-ready idle. Clear dialogue and reveal the boss name and health bar.
shots.environment_motion: Gate stays closed. Keep all damage inactive through the handoff.

boss_defeat.timing: Timed; skippable only after the boss legitimately reaches zero HP.
boss_defeat.trigger: Pharaoh HP reaches zero during the active encounter.

shots.camera: Hold arena camera; optional restrained shake obeys the user's setting.
shots.character_poses: Dave stops. Pharaoh begins the 16-frame disintegration at 12 fps, holding its last frame if necessary.
shots.environment_motion: Disable all encounter damage immediately. Summons stop; hazards and projectiles cannot hurt Dave.

shots.camera: Hold position while a smooth two-second fade reaches white.
shots.character_poses: Dave remains safe and still. Pharaoh dissolves completely.
shots.environment_motion: One continuous fade, never repeated flashing. Reduced-flash mode uses a slow dark dissolve.

shots.camera: Full white hold, or full dark hold under reduced flash.
shots.character_poses: Remove Pharaoh, summoned enemies, projectiles, telegraphs and hazards while obscured.
shots.environment_motion: Stop encounter loops; open the entry gate and dungeon route; make the unique reward available once.

shots.camera: Fade smoothly back to the unchanged arena camera over two seconds.
shots.character_poses: Dave stands in the cleared courtyard. Boss and summons are absent.
shots.environment_motion: Exit is visibly open. Resume low wind; remove the boss health bar.

shots.character_poses: Dave resumes normal idle. Release control and show objective_dungeon only when this sequence completes.
shots.environment_motion: The courtyard stays clear of encounter threats.

ending.timing: Timed until title; title waits indefinitely for Return to Main Menu.
ending.trigger: After victory, Dave fully crosses the dungeon doorway in rm_d18_dungeon_threshold.

shots.camera: Track Dave's last two steps toward the dark doorway; never reveal a playable interior.
shots.character_poses: Dave faces up into the entrance, red cape trailing. Halt him just beyond the threshold.
shots.environment_motion: Sand passes left outside; the interior remains still and dark.

shots.character_poses: Dave stands upright in silhouette; his determined portrait appears for the final brief line.
shots.environment_motion: Let the last sand drift fade at the entrance.

shots.camera: Fade evenly to black over one second.
shots.character_poses: Dave disappears only beneath the fade.
shots.environment_motion: Do not show the Grail, a new enemy or an interior location.

shots.camera: Static rm_ending presentation; title centred on the black or restrained entrance background.
shots.character_poses: No characters appear. Show the title; enable Return to Main Menu at sequence completion, after the music tail.

audio_cues.note: Leave the motif unresolved; tail ends at 10 s, then remain quiet.

persistence.scope: Proposed names for Claude's serializer; map to existing equivalents. A skipped scene and a normally finished scene commit the same current-run values. No narrative action silently overwrites a manual save slot.
persistence.checkpoint_load: Restore the selected snapshot as a whole, including boss, inventory and reward flags. An old pre-boss save legitimately restores an undefeated encounter; a saved completed-boss state must never replay that fight.
persistence.boss_retry: Show the two-line exchange on each fresh attempt unless a future user setting suppresses seen scenes. Seen-scene suppression must call boss_intro_complete. Gate entry is consumed once per attempt, not once for the whole campaign.
